## 🎉 What's New in v0.15.2

**Change the temperature on the thermostat, and your AC actually gets it.**

A focused fix for wrapped climate (AC) setups.

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### 🌡️ The AC now follows your temperature changes

**Previously the only moment a new setpoint reached the AC was when the thermostat switched it on.**

If your AC was already running — and stayed running — it kept whatever setpoint it had, no matter what you set on the thermostat. Since you usually adjust the temperature while the system is already going, the change appeared to be ignored almost every time.

Three things combined to cause it, and all three are fixed:

- On a **heater + AC** system the thermostat never told the AC that the target had moved. The notification stopped at the combined heater/cooler device instead of reaching the AC underneath it.
- On a **cooling-only** system the notification was never sent at all.
- When it *was* sent, it went out fractionally before the new temperature was recorded, so the old value could be passed along.

The thermostat now tells the AC the moment the target changes, in every mode, using the value you just set.

**What you'll notice:** adjust the temperature and the AC's own display follows within a second, instead of staying on its previous setting until the next time the thermostat cycled it off and on.

---

## 📊 By the Numbers

- **1 bug fix** — target temperature passthrough to a wrapped AC
- **1689 tests** — all passing
- **100% backward compatible** — no configuration changes needed
